interpretation: Negative values arise mechanically when the linear uncertainty penalty exceeds expected utility at low meaningful-season probabilities. The primary value layer contains no explicit salary, contract, draft-cost or roster-slot cost that would justify a negative player asset value.
decision: Treat negative values as a utility-layer defect. Do not floor values to zero because that would reintroduce a tied zero-value tail. Test a positive monotone risk discount as a separate hypothesis.
